This document lists the 
 equipment inspection checklist I2, to be performed every three years as 
 indicated by Y3 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Abdullah Elsayed M,
tested by eng. 
 Abdulatif Ahmed,
 accepted by electrical general director eng. 
 El Sayed Attiah Abd El Maksood, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control engineer Adel Abdel Kader El-Naggar, and approved 
 by eng. Fathy M Ragb: Head Sector of Talkha PS.

This 
document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality control 
general director, MPIS coordinator, and 
certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: EDEPC admin & financial inspection & 
quality control's general director and supervisor of inspection & quality 
control head sector

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety belts 
 ... etc.

items:
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance 
 staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

The breaker should be switched off and 
 disconnected out of its cell.
Disconnect the dc control voltage.
Complete tool of common keys and screw drivers.
Fine cloth for cleaning purposes
Brushes, grease and air blower
Digital multimeter

Clean the breaker from 
 any dust.

Check screw connections 
 for tightness.

Close and open the 
 breaker mechanically.

Check the manual 
 charging and discharging of the mechanism.

Check the connections of 
 earthing system .

Check the cable socket 
 of the breaker.

Check pushbuttons, 
 signal lamps ,fuses and auxiliary relays.
Check for SF6 leakage.

Check the value of 
 control voltage.

Check the charging and 
 discharging of the breaker electrically.

Check the operation of 
 the breaker from local in test position .

Check the operation of 
 the breaker from remote in test position .

Record the counter 
 reading.

Check and record the 
 circuit breaker resistance path .

Check and record the 
 circuit breaker closing and opening time .

Every 5000 operating 
 cycles clean and lubricate the operating mechanism including :
Latching mechanism.
Joints and bearings.
Springs guide.
